responsibility: Provides SuperH’s common option handling and optimization defaults for architecture selection. It defines SH-specific optimization presets such as division strategy and prefetch parameters, preserves TARGET_DEFAULT as the base flag set, and translates the many -m1/-m2/-m2a/-m3/-m4/-m4a family switches into the corresponding internal architecture-selection bits in target_flags so later SH backend code operates on a single normalized machine model.
